Titles.eng: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
Titles.jpn: ドラゴンボールZ 神と神

Summaries.eng: After the defeat of Majin Buu, a powerful God of Destruction known as Beerus searches for the Saiyan warrior who defeated Frieza. Realizing the threat Beerus poses to Earth, the Z-fighters must stop him. Only Goku, humanity’s last hope, can ascend to the level of a legendary Super Saiyan God and save the planet, and possibly the entire universe!

Aliases: Dragon Ball Z: Kami to Kami
Dragon Ball Z: God vs. God
Dragon Ball Z Movie 14: God & God
